paper.title_en: Constraining spinning primordial black holes with interstellar dust heating
paper.abstract_en: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are a well-motivated dark matter candidate, and their cosmic abundance is constrained by a variety of observational probes. PBHs in the mass range $10^{15}\,\text{g}\,{-}\,10^{17}\,\text{g}$ are evaporating today via Hawking radiation, a process that can heat interstellar dust and modify its thermal emission. Recent studies have used this effect to place constraints on the abundance of non-spinning PBHs. We extend this approach by investigating the influence of PBH spin on dust-heating constraints. Furthermore, we account for secondary photons that originate not only from the decay of gauge bosons but also from the decay of hadrons produced via the fragmentation of primary quarks and gluons emitted through Hawking radiation. By comparing the dust heating rate induced by spinning PBHs with the maximum cooling rate of dust, considering both silicate and graphite grains, we derive new upper limits on the fraction of dark matter in the form of PBHs, $f_{\rm PBH}$. Our results show that the constraints depend on both PBH mass and spin. Smaller PBHs with higher spin yield stronger limits. For example, in the cases we investigated, the strongest constraint is $f_{\rm PBH} \sim 1.5 \times 10^{-4}$ for $M_{\rm PBH} = 10^{15}{\rm g}$ and spin parameter $a_{*} = 0.9999$. Although these limits are less stringent than existing constraints in the same mass range, they provide a distinct and complementary approach to constraining the abundance of PBHs.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究自旋原初黑洞通过霍金辐射加热星际尘埃的限制，属于黑洞热力学与引力物理范畴，涉及霍金辐射、次级粒子与自旋效应，具有明确的理论深度与方法描述，适合进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用星际尘埃加热限制自旋原初黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞（PBHs）是一个动机充分的暗物质候选者，其宇宙丰度受到多种观测探针的限制。质量范围在 $10^{15}\,\text{g}\,{-}\,10^{17}\,\text{g}$ 的 PBHs 目前正在通过霍金辐射蒸发，这一过程可以加热星际尘埃并改变其热辐射。最近的研究利用这一效应来限制非自旋 PBHs 的丰度。我们通过研究 PBH 自旋对尘埃加热限制的影响来扩展这一方法。此外，我们不仅考虑了来自规范玻色子衰变的次级光子，还考虑了来自通过霍金辐射发射的初级夸克和胶子碎裂产生的强子衰变的次级光子。通过比较自旋 PBHs 引起的尘埃加热率与尘埃的最大冷却率，并同时考虑硅酸盐和石墨颗粒，我们得出了关于 PBHs 形式暗物质比例 $f_{\rm PBH}$ 的新上限。我们的结果表明，这些限制同时依赖于 PBH 质量和自旋。质量更小、自旋更高的 PBHs 给出更强的限制。例如，在我们研究的情形中，最强的限制为 $f_{\rm PBH} \sim 1.5 \times 10^{-4}$，对应 $M_{\rm PBH} = 10^{15}{\rm g}$ 和自旋参数 $a_{*} = 0.9999$。尽管这些限制在同一质量范围内不如现有约束严格，但它们提供了一种独特且互补的方法来限制 PBHs 的丰度。
